# Third-party source used by this experiment

- `stb_sprintf.h` is from `nothings/stb` commit
  `2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`. It is public domain or
  MIT licensed; the license text is at the end of that header.
- `ffc.h` is from `kolemannix/ffc.h` commit
  `965d4db45d03365b4c852ab34f4d5b08b53bc7b3`. It is available under
  the Boost Software License 1.0; see `ffc-LICENSE-BOOST`.

These components are compiled into the experimental library from source. They
are not Microsoft CRT binaries.
